segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Attracts deposits and makes commercial, residential and consumer loans for individuals, businesses and nonprofit organizations.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company's operations are considered to be aggregated in one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Deposits and borrowed funds are invested in loans and debt securities, earning interest income for the Company.
revenueModel.evidence: Our principal business consists of attracting deposits from the general public and investing those funds, along with borrowed funds, in commercial real estate loans, construction and development loans, commercial and industrial loans, equipment finance leases, municipal leases, loans secured by first and second mortgages on one-to-four family residences including home equity loans and other consumer loans.

changes.text: Ceased indirect auto originations and right-sized the mortgage banking line of business in 2024.
changes.evidence: In January 2024, the Company announced the decision to cease indirect auto originations and right-size our mortgage banking line of business.

changes.text: Sold the two Knoxville, Tennessee branches to a third party financial institution in 2025.
changes.evidence: On May 23, 2025, the Company completed the sale of the Bank's two branches located in Knoxville, Tennessee, to a third party financial institution.
